messages:
maya_fin: heads up - invoice NIM-0315-22 from NimbusCompute for $6,750 showed up in AP inbox. No PO attached and amount doesn't match any recurring billing. payment run scheduled in 24h. who owns this?
sarah_procure: thanks maya. vendor on our approved list but i can't find a PO number. last PO was NIM-PO-2024-01 for $60k annual. this looks like a monthly add-on.
dan_ops: likely product infra seat or burst nodes. dan_ops checking usage logs. can someone upload the invoice PDF?
maya_fin: link: https://files.redwood/example/NIM-0315-22.pdf
CoupaBot: System: Invoice NIM-0315-22 created by maya_fin. Matching rules: vendor+invoice_number -> no match. fuzzy match amount/date -> candidate PO NIM-PO-2024-01 (confidence 28%).
nimbus_billing: Hi Redwood finance team - this invoice is for March overage & seat add-ons under annual agreement. Our AP policy requires a PO or written approval per invoice. We can extend payment terms to Net30 if needed.

sarah_procure: nimbus_billing can you confirm account rep and contract line item? procurement needs to confirm whether this should have been rolled into the annual invoice.
nimbus_billing: Account rep: Jordan Lee (jordan@nimbus.io). Contract line: Appendix B - monthly overages. We billed them separately per contract language.

dan_ops: Confirmed: usage spikes on 2025-03-12 correlate with extra burst nodes for perf testing. Cost center should be PRODUCT-INFRA.
maya_fin: Finance needs explicit approval in thread for audit: approver name + cost center + amount. Also GL code (we use GL-5302 for cloud compute).
dan_ops: Approver here - I approve $6,750 for NimbusCompute invoice NIM-0315-22 charged to PRODUCT-INFRA, GL-5302. Approver: Dan O'Neill (dan_ops).
sarah_procure: i'll create a short-form PO NIM-PO-2025-03-ADM and attach to Coupa. ETA 90 minutes. procurement will note it as an overage PO and update contract owner.

CoupaBot: Action logged: PO NIM-PO-2025-03-ADM created by sarah_procure, linked to invoice NIM-0315-22. Audit note: approver dan_ops approved on Slack.
maya_fin: marking invoice for payment in the next run. vendor requested Net30; we'll pay in this cycle to maintain relationship. please follow up procurement to consolidate invoices monthly.
sarah_procure: will follow up with Jordan and request consolidated monthly billing and pre-approval for >$5k overages. I'll update vendor record and contract appendix.
nimbus_billing: thanks all, will confirm consolidation options.
maya_fin: closing thread - payment released after Coupa linkage. end.
